title: From Sentinel-2 to 1-m Imagery: Real-World $\times 10$ Cross-Sensor Super-Resolution via Visual Autoregressive Modeling
title_zh: 从Sentinel-2到1米影像：基于视觉自回归建模的现实世界×10跨传感器超分辨率

paragraphs.en: Reconstructing 1-m imagery from Sentinel-2 combines two difficulties. The input and the reference are observed by different satellites, which differ in spatial resolution, spectral response, radiometry, acquisition time, and local geometry, so no synthetic degradation operator links them. The required magnification of ten in each spatial dimension also far exceeds the factors of two to four at which remote sensing super-resolution is usually developed. We study this real-world × 10 \times 10 problem using YREB-SR, which pairs 2022 Sentinel-2 RGB composites with 2022 Jilin-1 RGB references resampled to a 1-m grid over the Yangtze River Economic Belt. The benchmark contains 11,559 geographically matched scene pairs, with 6,409, 2,135, and 3,015 assigned to training, validation, and testing, respectively. We develop CrossVAR, a visual autoregressive model that predicts the 1-m latent as a nine-scale hierarchy conditioned on the Sentinel-2 input and estimates the remaining quantization residual with a diffusion refiner run without injected noise. Complete 1600 × 1600 1600\times 1600 scenes are reconstructed in overlapping windows that start on the Sentinel-2 pixel grid, as every training patch does, and every window is decoded at the size on which the decoder was trained before the windows are blended with Gaussian weights. On all 3,015 test scenes, CrossVAR achieves 27.60 dB PSNR, 0.7725 SSIM, 0.1451 LPIPS, and 7.15 FID, the best value of each metric among the compared methods. These results establish a strong autoregressive baseline for large-scale cross-sensor reconstruction. To facilitate reproducibility, the source code and implementation are publicly available at https://github.com/SHANOAL/RSSR.

paragraphs.en: Sentinel-2 provides frequently, openly available observations for monitoring large geographic areas, but its 10-m visible bands do not resolve many roads, roofs, field boundaries, and small water features [ 1 ] . Very-high-resolution imagery can reveal these structures, although its coverage and acquisition conditions differ from those of medium-resolution missions. Super-resolution (SR) offers a way to estimate finer spatial structure from the available observations. Estimating 1-m imagery from Sentinel-2 is, however, considerably harder than the SR settings commonly studied in remote sensing, for two reasons.
paragraphs.zh: Sentinel-2 能够以较高的频率公开提供可用于监测大范围地理区域的观测数据，但其10米分辨率的可见光波段无法分辨许多道路、屋顶、田块边界和小型水体等要素 [ 1 ] 。 甚高分辨率影像能够揭示这些结构，但其覆盖范围和获取条件与中等分辨率任务有所不同。 超分辨率（SR）提供了一种从现有观测数据中估计更精细空间结构的方法。 然而，从 Sentinel-2 估计1米分辨率影像，比遥感领域通常研究的超分辨率设置要困难得多，原因有二。

paragraphs.en: First, the input and the reference are observed by different sensors. Most remote sensing SR methods learn from pairs in which the low-resolution (LR) image is synthesized from the high-resolution (HR) image by bicubic downsampling or a predefined blur kernel [ 2 , 3 ] . The two images then share the sensor, the acquisition time, and the radiometric processing, and the degradation is known exactly. Models trained on such pairs lose accuracy on real acquisitions, because the simulated degradation departs from the real one [ 4 ] . Independent satellites differ in optics and modulation transfer function, spectral response, radiometric calibration and product generation, atmospheric state, and acquisition date. In YREB-SR, a single three-channel input is a Sentinel-2 composite from 2022, whereas its Jilin-1 reference was acquired in 2022. Land-cover change and seasonal appearance thus add to the sensor differences. Their footprints are geographically matched, but exact pixel-wise correspondence is not assumed. The LR image is therefore not a degraded copy of the reference, and no degradation operator links the two. A model must learn the cross-sensor relation from paired data without treating every sensor or temporal disagreement with the reference as missing detail. Real-world benchmarks pair independent acquisitions for this reason, including Sentinel-2 with WorldView-2 in MuS2 [ 5 ] , with SPOT 6/7 in WorldStrat [ 6 ] , and with NAIP aerial imagery in S2-NAIP [ 7 ] , as well as Landsat 8, Sentinel-2, and PlanetScope in L8S2PS [ 8 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 首先，输入图像和参考图像由不同的传感器观测得到。 大多数遥感超分辨率方法从这样的图像对中学习：其中低分辨率（LR）图像由高分辨率（HR）图像通过双三次下采样或预定义的模糊核合成 [ 2 , 3 ] 。 这两幅图像共享同一传感器、采集时间和辐射处理流程，且退化过程是精确已知的。 在此类图像对上训练的模型在真实采集数据上会损失精度，因为模拟的退化与真实退化存在偏差 [ 4 ] 。 相互独立的卫星在光学系统与调制传递函数、光谱响应、辐射定标与产品生成、大气状态以及采集日期上各不相同。 在 YREB-SR 中，单一的三通道输入是 2022 年的 Sentinel-2 合成影像，而其对应的 Jilin-1 参考影像也采集于 2022 年。 因此，地表覆盖变化和季节性外观差异会叠加在传感器差异之上。 两者的覆盖范围在地理上是匹配的，但不假定存在精确的逐像素对应关系。 因此，LR 图像并非参考影像的退化副本，也没有任何退化算子将两者联系起来。 模型必须从成对数据中学习跨传感器关系，而不能把每一次与参考影像的传感器差异或时间差异都当作缺失的细节来处理。 正因如此，真实世界基准将相互独立的采集数据配成图像对，包括 MuS2 [ 5 ] 中的 Sentinel-2 与 WorldView-2、WorldStrat [ 6 ] 中的 Sentinel-2 与 SPOT 6/7、S2-NAIP [ 7 ] 中的 Sentinel-2 与 NAIP 航空影像，以及 L8S2PS [ 8 ] 中的 Landsat 8、Sentinel-2 和 PlanetScope。

paragraphs.en: Second, the magnification is far larger than in common practice. Most remote sensing SR methods operate at factors of two to four, because the problem becomes rapidly more ill-posed at higher magnification [ 9 ] , and real-world benchmarks likewise use moderate factors, such as three in L8S2PS [ 8 ] , or provide several Sentinel-2 acquisitions per reference [ 5 , 6 ] . Reconstructing 1-m imagery from a single 10-m Sentinel-2 image requires × 10 \times 10 , so each input pixel is expanded into 100 output pixels, compared with 16 at × 4 \times 4 . The nominal × 10 \times 10 ratio describes the output grid; it does not imply that one observed LR pixel is the arithmetic mean of the corresponding 100 reference pixels. Most of the structure in a 1-m output, such as individual buildings, narrow roads, and field boundaries, lies below the input sampling and must come from learned image priors. Strong priors produce sharp detail that the observation does not necessarily support, and the cross-sensor differences make the reference an imperfect target for learning such priors. The large factor also enlarges every scene, as a 160 × 160 160\times 160 Sentinel-2 input becomes a 1600 × 1600 1600\times 1600 output that exceeds the crop size used in training, so complete scenes must be assembled from overlapping windows without visible seams. Reconstruction-oriented CNNs and transformers provide fidelity baselines for this setting [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] , and adversarial and diffusion models offer perceptual priors [ 13 , 14 ] , so their comparison must use the same complete scenes and assess both reference fidelity and perceptual similarity.

paragraphs.en: Visual autoregressive modeling (VAR) predicts an image through a coarse-to-fine sequence of latent maps rather than a raster-ordered sequence of individual pixels [ 15 ] , and the hierarchy has also been conditioned on LR images for SR [ 16 ] . The hierarchy suits a large magnification, since its coarse scales fix the scene layout that the Sentinel-2 input constrains, and its finer scales add local structure from the learned prior. CrossVAR encodes the Sentinel-2 input into one condition token per latent position, predicts the 1-m latent as nine code maps with a next-scale transformer, and estimates the residual that the codes leave with a residual refiner. Two steps of this inference add error unrelated to the reference. First, the residual refiner samples the residual with injected noise, which adds variation that no reference supports. Second, the assembly of complete scenes departs from the conditions of training. At × 4 \times 4 , a 16-pixel latent position spans exactly four input pixels, so every window on the latent grid also starts on the input grid. At × 10 \times 10 , input pixels span 10 output pixels and latent positions span 16, so the two grids coincide only every 80 output pixels, and overlapping windows mostly start inside an input pixel, whereas every training patch starts on the input grid. Fusing the windows and decoding the scene in one pass further applies the VQ decoder to a latent field sixteen times larger than those seen in training. CrossVAR removes the first error by deterministic residual refinement and the second by aligned window decoding, which starts every window on the input grid and decodes it at the training size. Both act at inference and leave the trained weights unchanged. Fig. 1 places CrossVAR among the compared methods by fidelity and cost on the complete test scenes.

RRSISR captures LR and HR images of the same scene with a spectral camera [ 4 ] , and L8S2PS aligns Landsat 8, Sentinel-2, and PlanetScope images at a factor of three [ 8 ] . YREB-SR pairs a single Sentinel-2 composite with a 1-m Jilin-1 reference at × 10 \times 10 and evaluates complete scenes.

paragraphs.en: Reconstruction networks learn a direct mapping from the LR to the HR image, with residual convolutional blocks in EDSR [ 10 ] , window-based transformer blocks in SwinIR [ 11 ] , and top- k k token selection for remote sensing in TTST [ 12 ] . Arbitrary-scale methods decouple the output grid from a fixed factor, as LIIF queries a continuous representation from local features [ 18 ] and Thera integrates a Gaussian point-spread function with neural heat fields [ 19 ] . Generative methods pursue perceptually plausible detail [ 20 , 13 ] under the trade-off between distortion and perceptual quality [ 21 ] . Satlas-SR applies adversarial training to Sentinel-2 [ 7 ] , diffusion priors are explored by EDiffSR, RSDiffSR, SGDM, and TexADiff [ 14 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] , SEN2SR emphasizes radiometric and spatial consistency with the input [ 25 ] , and WaveDiffUR addresses ultra-large magnification with a wavelet-domain diffusion solver [ 9 ] .

paragraphs.en: Candidate locations were selected using the built-up class of ESA WorldCover as a spatial guide [ 30 ] . Stratified random sampling was conducted across the upstream, midstream, and downstream portions of the YREB to capture regional differences in surface structure and urbanization intensity. A minimum center-to-center distance of 3 km was imposed between sampling locations. Because each scene covers approximately 1.6 × 1.6 1.6\times 1.6 km 2 , this constraint prevents direct overlap between scene footprints and reduces immediate spatial redundancy. Although the sampling strategy emphasizes built-up environments containing high-frequency structures such as buildings, roads, and fragmented impervious surfaces, the resulting scenes also encompass vegetation, cropland, water bodies, bare land, and mixed rural landscapes. Figure 2 shows the geographic distribution of the resulting scene pairs and their dataset assignments.

paragraphs.en: The low-resolution (LR) images were derived from Sentinel-2 observations accessed through Google Earth Engine [ 31 ] . Source acquisitions with reported cloud coverage exceeding 20% were excluded, after which median compositing was applied to the remaining 2022 observations to reduce residual cloud and atmospheric contamination. Sentinel-2 provides a native spatial resolution of 10 m in the blue (B2), green (B3), and red (B4) bands [ 1 ] . These bands were retained and ordered as B4–B3–B2 to form natural-color RGB inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 低分辨率（LR）图像源自通过 Google Earth Engine [ 31 ] 获取的 Sentinel-2 观测数据。 报告云量超过 20% 的源影像被排除，随后对剩余的 2022 年观测数据进行中值合成，以减少残留云和大气污染的影响。 Sentinel-2 在蓝（B2）、绿（B3）和红（B4）波段提供 10 米的原生空间分辨率 [ 1 ] 。 保留这些波段并按 B4–B3–B2 的顺序排列，以构成自然色 RGB 输入。

paragraphs.en: For each sampling location, a 160 × 160 × 3 160\times 160\times 3 LR scene was extracted at the native 10-m grid spacing, corresponding to a nominal ground footprint of 1.6 × 1.6 1.6\times 1.6 km 2 . Each benchmark sample provides a single three-channel Sentinel-2 image as the model input. Other Sentinel-2 bands, multitemporal sequences, Sentinel-1 observations, semantic labels, and geographic metadata are not supplied to the reconstruction models. This design isolates the ability of each method to reconstruct fine spatial detail from natural-color medium-resolution imagery.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个采样位置，以原生 10 米网格间距提取一个 160 × 160 × 3 160\times 160\times 3 的低分辨率（LR）场景，对应约 1.6 × 1.6 1.6\times 1.6 平方公里的名义地面覆盖范围。 每个基准样本仅提供单幅三通道 Sentinel-2 图像作为模型输入。 其他 Sentinel-2 波段、多时相序列、Sentinel-1 观测数据、语义标签以及地理元数据均不提供给重建模型。 这一设计旨在隔离评估各方法从自然彩色中分辨率影像重建精细空间细节的能力。

sents.en: For each sampling location, a 160 × 160 × 3 160\times 160\times 3 LR scene was extracted at the native 10-m grid spacing, corresponding to a nominal ground footprint of 1.6 × 1.6 1.6\times 1.6 km 2 .

sents.zh: 这一设计旨在隔离评估各方法从自然彩色中分辨率影像重建精细空间细节的能力。

paragraphs.en: The high-resolution (HR) references were derived from 0.75-m RGB imagery acquired in 2022 by the Jilin-1 satellite constellation [ 32 ] . The source imagery was resampled to a uniform 1-m grid, from which 1600 × 1600 × 3 1600\times 1600\times 3 RGB scenes were extracted. Each HR scene therefore covers the same nominal 1.6 × 1.6 1.6\times 1.6 km 2 footprint as its corresponding Sentinel-2 input.
paragraphs.zh: 高分辨率（HR）参考影像源自吉林一号卫星星座于2022年获取的0.75米RGB影像[ 32 ]。 源影像被重采样到统一的1米网格，并从中提取出1600 × 1600 × 3 1600\times 1600\times 3的RGB场景。 因此，每个HR场景覆盖的名义地面范围与对应的Sentinel-2输入相同，均为1.6 × 1.6 1.6\times 1.6平方公里。

sents.en: The high-resolution (HR) references were derived from 0.75-m RGB imagery acquired in 2022 by the Jilin-1 satellite constellation [ 32 ] .
sents.zh: 高分辨率（HR）参考影像源自吉林一号卫星星座于2022年获取的0.75米RGB影像[ 32 ]。

sents.en: The source imagery was resampled to a uniform 1-m grid, from which 1600 × 1600 × 3 1600\times 1600\times 3 RGB scenes were extracted.
sents.zh: 源影像被重采样到统一的1米网格，并从中提取出1600 × 1600 × 3 1600\times 1600\times 3的RGB场景。

sents.en: Each HR scene therefore covers the same nominal 1.6 × 1.6 1.6\times 1.6 km 2 footprint as its corresponding Sentinel-2 input.
sents.zh: 因此，每个HR场景覆盖的名义地面范围与对应的Sentinel-2输入相同，均为1.6 × 1.6 1.6\times 1.6平方公里。

paragraphs.en: The Jilin-1 images are regarded as cross-sensor references rather than strictly simultaneous ground truth. The LR and HR observations differ in acquisition date, sensor optics, modulation transfer function, spectral response, radiometric representation, atmospheric conditions, and product-generation chain. These differences are intentionally retained because YREB-SR is designed to evaluate practical cross-sensor reconstruction rather than inversion of an analytically specified synthetic degradation.
paragraphs.zh: 吉林一号影像被视为跨传感器参考数据，而非严格同时相的地面真值。 低分辨率与高分辨率观测在获取日期、传感器光学系统、调制传递函数、光谱响应、辐射表征、大气条件以及产品生成流程上均存在差异。 这些差异被有意保留，因为 YREB-SR 旨在评估实用的跨传感器重建，而非对解析定义的合成退化的反演。

sents.en: The Jilin-1 images are regarded as cross-sensor references rather than strictly simultaneous ground truth.
sents.zh: 吉林一号影像被视为跨传感器参考数据，而非严格同时相的地面真值。

sents.en: The LR and HR observations differ in acquisition date, sensor optics, modulation transfer function, spectral response, radiometric representation, atmospheric conditions, and product-generation chain.
sents.zh: 低分辨率与高分辨率观测在获取日期、传感器光学系统、调制传递函数、光谱响应、辐射表征、大气条件以及产品生成流程上均存在差异。

sents.zh: 这些差异被有意保留，因为 YREB-SR 旨在评估实用的跨传感器重建，而非对解析定义的合成退化的反演。

paragraphs.en: For each sampling location, the Jilin-1 and Sentinel-2 images were extracted over the same geospatial extent using their associated georeferencing information. The Jilin-1 imagery was resampled by cubic interpolation to a 1600 × 1600 1600\times 1600 grid at a nominal 1-m ground sampling distance. The complete Sentinel-2 raster was independently reprojected and resampled over the corresponding extent to a 160 × 160 160\times 160 grid before extraction of bands B4, B3, and B2. Only locations for which both modalities were available and readable were retained, resulting in 11,559 complete RGB scene pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个采样点位，利用其对应的地理配准信息，提取相同地理空间范围内的吉林一号和Sentinel-2影像。 吉林一号影像通过三次插值重采样为1600 × 1600 1600\times 1600网格，标称地面采样距离为1米。 完整的Sentinel-2栅格在相应范围内被独立重投影和重采样为160 × 160 160\times 160网格，然后提取B4、B3和B2波段。 仅保留两种模态数据均可用且可读取的点位，最终得到11,559对完整的RGB场景对。

sents.en: For each sampling location, the Jilin-1 and Sentinel-2 images were extracted over the same geospatial extent using their associated georeferencing information.
sents.zh: 对于每个采样点位，利用其对应的地理配准信息，提取相同地理空间范围内的吉林一号和Sentinel-2影像。

sents.en: The Jilin-1 imagery was resampled by cubic interpolation to a 1600 × 1600 1600\times 1600 grid at a nominal 1-m ground sampling distance.
sents.zh: 吉林一号影像通过三次插值重采样为1600 × 1600 1600\times 1600网格，标称地面采样距离为1米。

sents.en: The complete Sentinel-2 raster was independently reprojected and resampled over the corresponding extent to a 160 × 160 160\times 160 grid before extraction of bands B4, B3, and B2.
sents.zh: 完整的Sentinel-2栅格在相应范围内被独立重投影和重采样为160 × 160 160\times 160网格，然后提取B4、B3和B2波段。

sents.en: Only locations for which both modalities were available and readable were retained, resulting in 11,559 complete RGB scene pairs.
sents.zh: 仅保留两种模态数据均可用且可读取的点位，最终得到11,559对完整的RGB场景对。

paragraphs.en: All standardized pairs are stored in the WGS 84 geographic coordinate system (EPSG:4326). Within each pair, the LR and HR rasters have identical geographic bounds and resolution-consistent affine transforms. Source projection information, spatial extent, affine transformation parameters, and NoData masks are propagated through the standardization procedure whenever available.
paragraphs.zh: 所有标准化配对均存储于 WGS 84 地理坐标系（EPSG:4326）中。 在每个配对中，LR 与 HR 栅格具有相同的地理范围以及分辨率一致的仿射变换。 在标准化流程中，只要源投影信息、空间范围、仿射变换参数和 NoData 掩膜可用，就会被完整传递。

sents.en: All standardized pairs are stored in the WGS 84 geographic coordinate system (EPSG:4326).
sents.zh: 所有标准化配对均存储于 WGS 84 地理坐标系（EPSG:4326）中。

sents.en: Within each pair, the LR and HR rasters have identical geographic bounds and resolution-consistent affine transforms.
sents.zh: 在每个配对中，LR 与 HR 栅格具有相同的地理范围以及分辨率一致的仿射变换。

sents.en: Source projection information, spatial extent, affine transformation parameters, and NoData masks are propagated through the standardization procedure whenever available.
sents.zh: 在标准化流程中，只要源投影信息、空间范围、仿射变换参数和 NoData 掩膜可用，就会被完整传递。

paragraphs.en: Sentinel-2 digital values are divided by 10,000 and stored as float32 surface reflectance, whereas the HR references retain their uint8 RGB representation. No histogram matching, color transfer, or sensor-to-sensor radiometric normalization is applied. The benchmark therefore preserves the actual cross-sensor radiometric discrepancy rather than imposing an artificially harmonized color relationship.
paragraphs.zh: Sentinel-2 的数字值除以 10,000 并以 float32 格式存储为地表反射率，而高分辨率参考影像则保留其 uint8 的 RGB 表示。 不进行任何直方图匹配、颜色迁移或传感器间辐射归一化处理。 因此，该基准保留了真实的跨传感器辐射差异，而不是强加人为统一的颜色关系。

sents.en: Sentinel-2 digital values are divided by 10,000 and stored as float32 surface reflectance, whereas the HR references retain their uint8 RGB representation.
sents.zh: Sentinel-2 的数字值除以 10,000 并以 float32 格式存储为地表反射率，而高分辨率参考影像则保留其 uint8 的 RGB 表示。

sents.en: No histogram matching, color transfer, or sensor-to-sensor radiometric normalization is applied.
sents.zh: 不进行任何直方图匹配、颜色迁移或传感器间辐射归一化处理。

sents.en: The benchmark therefore preserves the actual cross-sensor radiometric discrepancy rather than imposing an artificially harmonized color relationship.
sents.zh: 因此，该基准保留了真实的跨传感器辐射差异，而不是强加人为统一的颜色关系。

paragraphs.en: The quality-control procedure verifies file readability, paired filenames, band availability, raster dimensions, data types, geographic bounds, affine transforms, and NoData values. Dataset-level streaming statistics are additionally computed for each band, including the minimum, maximum, mean, standard deviation, and value histogram. Missing, corrupted, or unmatched files are recorded in an error log and excluded before dataset partitioning.
paragraphs.zh: 质量控制流程会校验文件可读性、成对文件名、波段可用性、栅格尺寸、数据类型、地理范围、仿射变换以及 NoData 值。 此外，还会针对每个波段计算数据集级别的流式统计信息，包括最小值、最大值、均值、标准差和数值直方图。 缺失、损坏或不匹配的文件会被记录到错误日志中，并在数据集划分之前予以排除。

sents.en: The quality-control procedure verifies file readability, paired filenames, band availability, raster dimensions, data types, geographic bounds, affine transforms, and NoData values.
sents.zh: 质量控制流程会校验文件可读性、成对文件名、波段可用性、栅格尺寸、数据类型、地理范围、仿射变换以及 NoData 值。

sents.en: Dataset-level streaming statistics are additionally computed for each band, including the minimum, maximum, mean, standard deviation, and value histogram.
sents.zh: 此外，还会针对每个波段计算数据集级别的流式统计信息，包括最小值、最大值、均值、标准差和数值直方图。

sents.en: Missing, corrupted, or unmatched files are recorded in an error log and excluded before dataset partitioning.
sents.zh: 缺失、损坏或不匹配的文件会被记录到错误日志中，并在数据集划分之前予以排除。

paragraphs.en: Unlike conventional SR datasets, the LR images in YREB-SR are not generated from the HR references using bicubic downsampling, Gaussian filtering, additive noise, or a predefined degradation kernel. Instead, each pair consists of independent observations acquired by two satellite systems. The LR–HR relationship consequently includes sensor-specific optical responses, radiometric differences, temporal and seasonal changes, atmospheric variability, and residual local misregistration. It cannot be represented by a single deterministic degradation operator.
paragraphs.zh: 与传统超分辨率数据集不同，YREB-SR 中的低分辨率图像并非由高分辨率参考图像通过双三次下采样、高斯滤波、加性噪声或预定义的退化核生成。 相反，每一对图像都由两个卫星系统独立观测获得。 因此，低分辨率–高分辨率之间的关系包含了传感器特定的光学响应、辐射差异、时间与季节变化、大气变异性以及残余的局部错位。 这种关系无法用单一的确定性退化算子来表示。

sents.zh: 与传统超分辨率数据集不同，YREB-SR 中的低分辨率图像并非由高分辨率参考图像通过双三次下采样、高斯滤波、加性噪声或预定义的退化核生成。

sents.en: Instead, each pair consists of independent observations acquired by two satellite systems.
sents.zh: 相反，每一对图像都由两个卫星系统独立观测获得。

sents.en: The LR–HR relationship consequently includes sensor-specific optical responses, radiometric differences, temporal and seasonal changes, atmospheric variability, and residual local misregistration.
sents.zh: 因此，低分辨率–高分辨率之间的关系包含了传感器特定的光学响应、辐射差异、时间与季节变化、大气变异性以及残余的局部错位。

sents.en: It cannot be represented by a single deterministic degradation operator.
sents.zh: 这种关系无法用单一的确定性退化算子来表示。

paragraphs.en: The pairs are geographically matched at the scene level, but exact pixel-wise correspondence is not assumed. A 10-m Sentinel-2 pixel nominally corresponds to a 10 × 10 10\times 10 region on the 1-m reference grid; however, its measured value is determined by the Sentinel-2 imaging process rather than by direct averaging of the corresponding 100 Jilin-1 pixels. This distinction separates YREB-SR from synthetically downsampled benchmarks and more closely reflects operational cross-sensor reconstruction.
paragraphs.zh: 这些图像对在场景层级上进行了地理配准，但不假设存在精确的逐像素对应关系。 一个10米分辨率的Sentinel-2像素名义上对应于1米参考网格上的一个 10 × 10 10\times 10 区域；然而，其测量值由Sentinel-2成像过程决定，而非通过对相应的100个吉林一号像素直接平均得到。 这一区别使YREB-SR有别于合成降采样的基准数据集，并更贴近地反映了实际业务中的跨传感器重建。

sents.zh: 这些图像对在场景层级上进行了地理配准，但不假设存在精确的逐像素对应关系。

paragraphs.en: Following quality control, the 11,559 scenes were randomly shuffled using a fixed seed and partitioned at the scene level into 6,409 training, 2,135 validation, and 3,015 test pairs. These subsets account for 55.45%, 18.47%, and 26.08% of the complete dataset, respectively. Scene identities are mutually exclusive across the three subsets. Furthermore, the 3-km minimum sampling distance ensures that their image footprints do not directly overlap, although the random partition is not intended to constitute a geographically blocked holdout experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 经过质量控制后，这 11,559 个场景使用固定随机种子进行了随机打乱，并在场景层面划分为 6,409 个训练对、2,135 个验证对和 3,015 个测试对。 这些子集分别占完整数据集的 55.45%、18.47% 和 26.08%。 场景标识在三个子集之间互不重叠。 此外，3 公里的最小采样距离确保了各影像覆盖范围不会直接重叠，尽管随机划分并非旨在构成一项地理分块的留出实验。

sents.zh: 经过质量控制后，这 11,559 个场景使用固定随机种子进行了随机打乱，并在场景层面划分为 6,409 个训练对、2,135 个验证对和 3,015 个测试对。

sents.en: Scene identities are mutually exclusive across the three subsets.

paragraphs.en: Overall, YREB-SR differs from commonly used synthetic SR datasets in three principal respects. First, it evaluates an extreme × 10 \times 10 reconstruction from native 10-m Sentinel-2 imagery to a 1-m VHR reference. Second, the LR images are independent cross-sensor observations rather than artificial degradations of the HR targets. Third, evaluation is conducted on a large and geographically heterogeneous collection of complete scenes under a fixed protocol. Together, these characteristics establish a reproducible and practically relevant benchmark for real-world cross-sensor remote sensing super-resolution.

A training patch covers 40 × 40 40\times 40 input pixels, so its corner lies both on the input grid, with a spacing of 10 output pixels, and on the latent grid, with a spacing of 16, and the two grids coincide every 80 output pixels. paragraphs.en: Table III reports the four metrics on the 3,015 test scenes. CrossVAR obtains 27.6008 dB PSNR, 0.7725 SSIM, 0.1451 LPIPS, and 7.1486 FID, the best value of every metric. The compared methods fall into two groups. It exceeds Thera by 2.30 dB PSNR and 0.087 SSIM and lowers the LPIPS and FID of Satlas-SR by 33% and 57%, respectively.

paragraphs.en: Fig. 4 examines where the gain of CrossVAR arises. Panel (a) compares the radially averaged power spectrum of each reconstruction with that of the Jilin-1 reference. Below 0.05 cycles per meter, the Nyquist frequency of the Sentinel-2 input, the reconstruction networks and Thera stay within 1.8 dB of the reference and CrossVAR within 0.2 dB, since this band is observed in the input. Above it, the methods separate. Between 0.05 and 0.15 cycles per meter, the reconstruction networks and Thera retain 10.6 to 14.0 dB less power than the reference, Satlas-SR 1.4 dB less, and CrossVAR 1.8 dB less. The mean gradient magnitude of the reconstructions reaches 0.28 to 0.34 of that of the reference for the reconstruction networks and Thera, 0.77 for Satlas-SR, and 0.74 for CrossVAR. CrossVAR therefore keeps nearly as much fine structure as the adversarial model while its PSNR is 4.30 dB higher.

paragraphs.en: Distortion and perceptual quality are known to compete in SR [ 21 ] , and the baselines in Table III follow this pattern. At × 10 \times 10 , the competition is governed by the frequencies that the Sentinel-2 input does not observe. A network trained with a pixel loss predicts the conditional mean of these frequencies, and because many fine structures are consistent with the same input pixels, this mean carries little power, as Fig. 4 (a) shows. An adversarial model restores the power, but the restored structures need not lie where the reference places them, which lowers PSNR. CrossVAR selects the fine structure as discrete codes conditioned on coarser code maps, and the coarse maps fix the layout that the input constrains (Fig. 5 ). A likely explanation for its gain in both fidelity and perceptual quality is that the fine codes are placed relative to an already correct layout, so the reconstruction keeps both the power and much of the position of fine structure. The residual temperature offers an explicit control over the remaining balance. With aligned windows, τ = 1 \tau=1 gives the lowest FID and τ = 0 \tau=0 the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS (Table VI ), and τ = 0 \tau=0 is used throughout because the benchmark measures agreement with the reference.

paragraphs.en: The misalignment addressed in Section IV-F arises whenever the number of output pixels per input pixel does not divide the latent stride. At × 3 \times 3 and × 6 \times 6 the two grids coincide every 48 output pixels, and at × 10 \times 10 every 80. Fig. 7 shows that a start 0.2 input pixels away from the grid already costs 0.6 to 0.7 dB. paragraphs.en: The Sentinel-2 composites and the Jilin-1 references come from different sensors and different acquisition dates, and their footprints are matched geographically rather than registered pixel by pixel. paragraphs.en: The benchmark covers the Yangtze River Economic Belt, and its random scene-level partition is not a geographically blocked holdout. Transfer to other climates and landscapes and the use of other spectral bands remain to be tested. paragraphs.en: We studied real-world × 10 \times 10 reconstruction from a single Sentinel-2 RGB composite using the 11,559 geographically matched pairs in YREB-SR. CrossVAR predicts the 1-m latent as nine code maps and a continuous residual, refines the residual without injected noise, and reconstructs complete scenes in windows that keep the input alignment and the decoder size of training. On the fixed 3,015-scene test split, CrossVAR obtains 27.60 dB PSNR, 0.7725 SSIM, 0.1451 LPIPS, and 7.15 FID. Scene-wise and spectral analyses show that the advantage over the retrained baselines holds across scene complexity and region and that CrossVAR keeps most of the power of fine structure above the Sentinel-2 Nyquist frequency while placing it far more accurately than adversarial models. Future work will estimate the continuous residual more closely from the Sentinel-2 input, add multi-temporal and multi-spectral observations, and reduce the inference cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用 YREB-SR 中 11,559 对地理匹配样本，研究了基于单幅 Sentinel-2 RGB 合成影像的真实场景 × 10 \times 10 重建。 CrossVAR 将 1 米潜变量预测为九张码图和一个连续残差，在不注入噪声的情况下对残差进行精化，并在保持输入对齐和训练时解码器尺寸的窗口内重建完整场景。 在固定的 3,015 景测试集划分上，CrossVAR 取得了 27.60 dB PSNR、0.7725 SSIM、0.1451 LPIPS 和 7.15 FID。 逐场景与光谱分析表明，相对于重新训练的基线模型的优势在各种场景复杂度和区域上都保持不变，而且 CrossVAR 在 Sentinel-2 奈奎斯特频率之上保留了大部分精细结构的能量，同时其空间定位精度远高于对抗模型。 未来的工作将更贴近地从 Sentinel-2 输入中估计连续残差，加入多时相和多光谱观测，并降低推理成本。
